thread:
tanvi: Preflight notice: planning v3.8.0 staged rollout in the 23:00-01:00 change window. Need EU-edge canary path.
release-bot: Preflight started for v3.8.0 (artifact abc123). Canary plan: 1% x10m -> 5% x15m -> 25% x30m. Smoke tests PASS.
sam: confirm start time for eu-west traffic?
tanvi: proposed 23:05; ops asked for quiet window 23:00-00:30.
kevin: infra has a scheduled migration at 23:10 on some eu-west nodes. can we move to 23:40 to avoid overlap?
maria: product ok with 23:40 but build promotion will be delayed ~30m.
luca-oncall: if shifted, extend the 1% canary to 15m and re-run warmups. set fallback thresholds: 5xx > 1.5% or kv-cache OOM -> immediate rollback.
release-bot: Pin recommendation: set rollback target to v3.7.9.
tanvi: pin v3.7.9 as rollback target.
release-bot: rollback_target=v3.7.9 recorded.
sam: ready to promote when command posted. command: `releasebot promote --artifact abc123 --to 1% --duration 15m --pin v3.7.9 --window 23:40-00:30`
kevin: infra can delay migration to 00:15 if we start at 23:40. good margin.
(deploy-bot) Deploy started: pushing 1% canary to eu-west.
deploy-bot: Canary 1% deployed. healthchecks nominal.
sam: manual probe: `curl -I https://eu-edge.redwood/api/health` -> 200 across probes.
(deploy-bot) +12m: healthcheck: p95 decode latency +12% but within SLO. no 5xx.
sam: proceed to 5% after 15m.
kevin: +1 infra.
luca-oncall: monitoring dash to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 5% now.
(deploy-bot) +5m into 5%: anomaly detected. eu-west-2 502 spike to 2.1% over 2m window.
kevin: seeing GC pauses on subset of nodes correlated with the spike. investigating.
luca-oncall: recommend PAUSE and demote back to 1% while infra mitigates.
tanvi: PAUSE. issuing rollback to pinned v3.7.9 for eu-west.
release-bot: `releasebot rollback --to v3.7.9 --scope eu-west --from 5% --reason "502 spike"`
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress: demoting v3.8.0 to v3.7.9.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete for eu-west. traffic restored to v3.7.9. Healthchecks returning to baseline.
kevin: infra patched GC scheduling on affected nodes; will monitor for 10m.
maria: updated RL-4512 release notes with rollback and root cause.
sam: follow-up action: add GC-heavy synthetic to preflight and increase canary hold for similar patterns.
tanvi: agreed. @kevin please add to infra preflight checklist.
luca-oncall: I'll own the incident doc and postmortem.
tanvi: thanks everyone. we will retarget v3.8.0 for the next change window after infra verifies stability. :thumbsup:
